encoding_notes: LIVE GUIDE BOT-BLOCKED: tandfonline.com Instructions for Authors (rsmf20) returned 403 on WebFetch and on Apify headless render; no Wayback snapshot within 12 months (newest instructions capture is 2022-06-28, a cookie-redirect shell). layout.font (Times New Roman 12), line_spacing (double), margins_mm (25.4 all = 1 inch), headings scheme, misc.title_case (sentence), running_head (not required at submission) = Taylor & Francis HOUSE-STYLE (authorservices manuscript-layout-guide), NOT this journal's own guide; may be overridden by the live RSMF instructions. T&F also offers optional format-free submission for many journals.

figures block (separate_files, formats tiff/jpeg/eps, min_dpi, legends in manuscript text, Figure {n} naming) = T&F house-style (authorservices submit-electronic-artwork): 'You must save figures separately to text, do not embed them in the manuscript file'; peer-review preferred formats JPEG/TIFF (+ Word); EPS recommended for line art.
SCHEMA GAP - tiered figure DPI: T&F house-style specifies color 300dpi, grayscale/combination 600dpi, line-art 1200dpi; schema holds one min_dpi so set to the 300 floor (color photos).

blinding = double-anonymized: set from the standardized T&F peer-review statement ('anonymized (double-anonymized) refereeing by at least two referees') surfaced via WebSearch since the live guide was blocked; separate_title_page + scrub flags are the standard corollaries. VERIFY against the live Instructions for Authors.

references.style = 'custom' because the journal-specific reference/citation style could not be verified (live guide blocked; no clean OA SMF article reachable to observe output); in_text/order/journal_abbrev left null. T&F sport-science journals vary between numbered and author-date - do NOT assume. Re-encode when the live guide is reachable.

article_types derived from the aims & scope (WebSearch-corroborated: 'in addition to original research, review articles, clinical case studies, short communications/technical reports are considered'): original_research, review, case_report (clinical case studies), technical_note (short communications/technical reports). Full article-type list + per-type word caps are in the blocked guide.
